map.泵站效率计算 使用指南: Pump Station Efficiency Calculator User Guide
map.输入流量、扬程、轴功率，计算水泵有效功率、运行效率与能耗（水的密度 ρ=1000: Enter flow, head and shaft power to compute the effective pump power, operating efficiency and energy use (water density rho = 1000 kg/m3, g = 9.81 m/s2)
map.按输入电功率与有效水力功率算站效。: Compute station efficiency from the input electrical power and effective hydraulic power.
map.多机组并联经济运行。: Economic operation with multiple units in parallel.
map.变频改造节能评估。: Energy-saving assessment for a variable-frequency retrofit.
map.：有效 P=ρgQH=1000×9.81×0.06×30≈17.7 kW、输入: Effective power P = rho g Q H = 1000 x 9.81 x 0.06 x 30 = about 17.7 kW with 21 kW input gives eta = 17.7/21 = about 84%, the rest being motor and drive loss.
map.：偏离高效点流量时 η 跌，多机组按负荷启停维持高效区。: Off the best-efficiency point the efficiency eta drops, so with multiple units start and stop them by load to stay in the high-efficiency band.
map.管路（壁厚/流速/压降）设计: Piping (Wall Thickness / Velocity / Pressure Drop) Design
map.泵效是单机，站效含电机、传动、管路，整体更低，是节能考核指标。: Pump efficiency is for a single pump, while station efficiency includes the motor, the drive and the piping, so it is lower overall and is the metric used for energy-saving assessment.
map.选高效机组、变频调速、减少节流与管路损失。: Choose high-efficiency units, use variable-frequency drives, and cut throttling and piping losses.
